Upgrade Your Productivity Instantly with Chatster: AI Assistant

NEW!! - Revolutionary Image Editing - Now in ImageGen on your iPhone or Mac!

Transform Your Images with AI-Powered Editing. Take your creativity to the next level with our brand-new image editing capabilities in ImageGen!

• Upload & Transform - Start with any photo from your gallery or capture a new one with your camera. Our AI will reimagine it based on your creative vision.

• Smart Edit Mode - Simply type "Edit image:" or "Change image:" followed by your request. Want to add a sunset? Remove an object? Change the style to watercolor? Modify a logo? Just ask!

• Seamless Image Evolution - Build upon your creations iteratively. Each edit preserves your previous changes, allowing you to craft the perfect image step by step.

► Professional Productivity: Your new best friend at work. From drafting business proposals, enhancing your marketing copy, or even upgrading your resume… our AI-powered chatbot elevates your work, saves you time and increases your ROI

► AI Image Creation & Editing: With our latest update, you can now transform text prompts into beautiful artwork through advanced AI powered by FLUX.1 Kontext. Logos, icons, drawings and custom images can be effortlessly created from scratch and edited through your direction. The best AI Logo Maker, Art Creator, Drawing Generator in the app store. ALL of your design needs

► DocsAI - Upload Documents: DocsAI is more than just a document reader—it’s your personal assistant that brings a new level of efficiency to your document management. From detailed reviews to quick edits, let DocsAI help you unlock the full potential of every word

► VisionAI - identify objects and text in images, instantly. Use it to translate, identify plants, dogs, fashion, & more! Or create ImageGen prompts from photos you already have

► A+ Study Partner: Say goodbye to late-night cram sessions! Chatster AI is your ultimate study buddy. Whether it's math, science, or history, our chatbot can answer your questions, simplify complex concepts, and turn homework stress into smooth sailing

► The New Google: Tired of endless search results? Chatster AI, powered by ChatGPT 4o, delivers spot-on information without the clutter. No more digging through irrelevant ads—just the answers you need, right at your fingertips

► Writing Excellence: Eliminate writer’s block with instant inspiration. Emails, resumes, essays, blogs, cover letters and more can help take your projects to new heights with Chatster’s AI assistance

► Endless Education: Education is the key to unlocking your potential. Elevate your education with Chatster AI today and experience a new era of personalized, accessible, and effective learning. It's time to embrace the future of education

Elevate your everyday life with Chatster AI. Experience the future of AI-powered Writer, Document Analyzer & Creative assistance—it's time to chat, create, and conquer!


How Does It Work?

• Advanced Language Processing: Chatster AI utilizes advanced language processing algorithms, including GPT-4.1/5 developed by OpenAI, to understand natural language queries and provide accurate and helpful responses in real-time. It will blow your mind!

• Image Generation: Creating AI-generated art is now simple. Our AI image generator uses the power of artificial intelligence to transform your written prompts into beautiful artwork, logo, realistic photos, and anything else you can describe just using text.

Premium:
• Subscriber has unlimited access to Chatster AI and up to 50 images a week powered by ChatGPT 4.1/5 API. Subscribers pay the fixed price for your country. Prices listed in USD
• Unsubscribed user may only use services with limited quota per day
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
